title: Record the adjacent reflections of the scaled E8 roots
body:
## Summary
- Eight adjacent reflections of the scaled E8 roots transport all 120 lines, 960 images in total.
- Each matrix `4I - alpha alpha^T` squares to `16I` across 512 entries, so the reflections are invertible over the half-integers.
- The image label is the adjacent transposition of the original label. The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/e8-reflection-transport/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/e8-reflection-transport/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/e8-reflection-transport`
